g.text: BEACON NODE (x3) - one per zone: bedroom_wing (1), dining_hall (2), medicine_room (11).

g.desc: BEACON NODE (x3) - one per zone: bedroom_wing (1), dining_hall (2), medicine_room (11).

g.text: ESP32 DevKitC 38-pin plugged into two 1x19 female headers on a 5 x 7 cm perfboard.

g.desc: ESP32 DevKitC 38-pin plugged into two 1x19 female headers on a 5 x 7 cm perfboard.

g.text: Power: 5 V USB phone charger into the devkit's own micro-USB. No other supply wiring.

g.desc: Power: 5 V USB phone charger into the devkit's own micro-USB. No other supply wiring.

g.text: R1 and D1 are optional: an outside status LED that blinks with the beacon heartbeat (IO2).
